title: Valthorne RPG
description: The revolutionary RPG server, in English & Spanish.
body:
Valthorne is an MMO RPG server focused on a centrical story with lots and lots of features to discover like physical economy (item-based), dialogs npc-to-player, physical markets instead of the casual _/shop_

![Kael's house in Valthorne](https://i.postimg.cc/zVmnv4nB/2026-03-05-16-03-44.png)

# Currently we're under heavy development!

Join us at https://discord.gg/8Sts7E9FRp to see the progress of **Valthorne** and how we're making it!

Note that you won't need to install mods to play Valthone, but we'll provide a modpack to make Valthorne experience at a higher level.
